notes: Unnumbered table: a boxed location key printed under the charts of Figure 5.51 (page 418) and Figure 5.52 (page 419). It is not a numbered manual table.
Both pages print the same key with identical wording and numbering; the two page regions are recorded together here rather than as duplicate records.
The key is printed as five side-by-side blocks of 14 numbered entries. Columns are kept in that printed order, so row 1 holds entries 1, 15, 29, 43 and 57.

Names are transcribed as printed, including 'Bijnore', 'Allahbad u/s (Ujahni, Fatehpur)', 'D/s at Kaithy', 'Dashashawmedh Ghat', 'Dakshineswar (Middle)' and 'Kannauj u/s (a/c with Ramganga & b/c with Kali)'. No spellings were normalised.

transcription.method: Direct visual reading of the annotation-cleaned 144 dpi full-page PNGs and 288-300 dpi region crops, with sideways pages rotated upright before reading; no OCR, no native-text values, no paid service
transcription.observations: First reading only. Every cell, power, dash, blank and footnote was read from the image and retained as printed; printed anomalies are listed in notes and were not corrected.

visual_recheck.method: Distinct parent visual comparison against source-region PNGs and rotated or zoomed crops; not independent human review
visual_recheck.observations: Compared every table cell and formula term; checked footnotes, blank cells, numerical outliers and skipped row numbering. Corrected entry 69 to printed Dakshineswar (Middle).
